canonical_title: Anthropic agrees to spend $45 billion on Nscale compute capacity
treatment: Treat as a distinct Anthropic compute-capacity procurement story. Reinclude only for official confirmation, material contract changes, deployment milestones, or disclosed financing/infrastructure details.
known_facts: Reuters reported, citing a person familiar with the matter, that Anthropic will spend $45 billion to rent AI computing power from Nscale's West Virginia data center campus.
The agreement is described as six years and about 460 megawatts of power capacity.
Nscale will deploy NVIDIA Vera Rubin chips for Anthropic's workloads.
Anthropic declined to comment to Reuters at publication time.
reinclude_only_if: Anthropic or Nscale officially confirms the agreement or publishes contract terms.
The campus reaches a material construction, energization, or deployment milestone.
GPU counts, rack/network design, exact capacity schedule, or financing structure are disclosed.
The agreement is materially expanded, reduced, delayed, terminated, or replaced.
notes: Reuters publication time 2026-08-26 17:21 UTC = 2026-08-27 02:21 JST. The report says the agreement covers roughly 460 MW over six years and uses NVIDIA Vera Rubin.
